name: Welcome
source:
This is a very short (~5 mins) visual novel about a trans woman trying to get home from work at night. It's closely based on a true story.

[From [url=https://sammystudio.itch.io/welcome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部流程很短的视觉小说，约五分钟，讲述一名跨性别女性夜间下班回家的经历。故事紧密依据真实事件改编。

[摘自[url=https://sammystudio.itch.io/welcome]Itch.io[/url]]
